_note: Paths for scripts/tailor_cv.py (the local tailor, writing from private/experience_bank.yaml). Path A also holds the Track A sub-types and their classifier, which the Workshop's Worker bundles at deploy, so both tailors classify alike. Headlines are cv-data.json taglines.<tagline>; Workshop summaries are cv-data.json summaries.<summary>. Skills rows come from cv-data.json, in the sub-type's order (rows not listed are dropped); skillAppend is local-tailor only.

classifier._note: Deterministic and shared: the Worker (cf-worker/src/classify.js, bundled at deploy) and the local tailor (scripts/tailor_classify.py) both apply these rules. Patterns are case-insensitive. Insight and marketing score one point per phrase found; A-Product needs at least minSignals of its signals and then scores weight per signal. A lead of margin points or fewer is a close call and defaults to closeCallDefault.

signals.name: product analytics / product data science in the title
partners with product managers, engineering or ML teams
product experimentation on a live app or platform
